section: 21.6 How a node finds the cluster / Downing with a lease

section: 21.7 A message the old node cannot read
text: The old node's serializer throws SerializationException for the unknown manifest (section 10.3), and Akka.NET's documentation (Serialization, "Serializer with String Manifest") is specific about what remoting does then: the exception is treated as transient, logged, and the message dropped, while any other exception tears down the connection between the two nodes.
author: Akka.NET project
title: Serialization (Akka.NET docs)
verification: curl of doc page; text search
evidence: "SerializationException is treated as a transient problem in the TCP based remoting layer. The problem will be logged and message is dropped. Other exceptions will tear down the TCP connection because it can be an indication of corrupt bytes from the underlying transport."
